note: pptSetId is the provider's OWN set id from /sets (an ObjectId hex string) and is what /cards?setId= accepts. It is NOT the numeric setId that appears inside card payloads — those are a different internal field. Our catalogue's pokemontcg.io slugs are honoured by neither: a request using the slug is silently ignored and billed anyway. See the 2026-08-23 report.
